segments.name: Consumer
segments.description: Partners with companies to offer payments and consumer lending products.
segments.evidence: The Consumer segment includes the Partner Solutions business line, which collaborates with partners to navigate payment and lending needs.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.description: Lends to businesses through commercial finance products nationwide.
segments.evidence: These products include term lending, asset-based lending, factoring, lease financing, government guaranteed lending, and other commercial finance products offered on a nationwide basis.

segments.name: Corporate Services/Other
segments.description: Holds corporate functions and other activities outside the two lending segments.
segments.evidence: The Bank, a wholly-owned full-service banking subsidiary of Pathward Financial, operates through three reportable segments (Consumer, Commercial, and Corporate Services/Other).

revenueModel.text: Partners, borrowers and depositors pay interest and fees on loans and banking programmes.
revenueModel.evidence: The Commercial segment includes the Company's Commercial Finance business line, which helps businesses access funds they need to launch, operate, and grow.
